about: Offline perp market contracts from exact merged source. Every figure, market, dex, agent and time is made up; times are minutes before one made-up instant. api-source rows are Candle's own `GET /api/v1/agent/perps-markets/:coin` route and its governed market-data reads, run against a stand-in Hyperliquid (requests lists each venue read one page load makes); the agents half is Candle's pure composeMarketAgents on three made-up public agents' published bundles, put in where the route reads the database. The bundles carry a made-up wallet, account value and fill hash that no row carries; the builder dex's made-up deployer is named by its role. mcp, sdk and cli rows read the same answer through the registered tool, the SDK and `candle perps market <coin> --agents` over an intercepted fetch. docs rows are the public pages' own lines, read as text. The database, the public gate and the venue are not executed, and no deployed behavior is claimed.

outcome.text: - `GET /api/v1/agent/perps-markets/{coin}`: one perp market and Candle's agents in it (BE-3777), no credential. `market` is Hyperliquid's public figures (mark, 24 h change, funding now, open interest, 24 h volume; a builder-dex market, `dex:COIN`, also names its dex, deployer and oracle source), `funding.points` the last 24 hours of funding, and `agents` the public agents in the market from the published perps bundle: how many are long and short, `netSize`, each open position (`label` like `Long BTC 20x`, size, entry, mark, P&L and `returnOnEquity`, each with `asOfMs`) and recent closed rounds with their `roundId`. Only published agents appear; no wallet address, order id or account value. The figures come from shared cached reads inside Candle's Hyperliquid budget, so concurrent requests for one coin make one upstream read. `agents` is `null` with `agentsUnavailable: true` while the board has no complete build. 404 `MARKET_NOT_FOUND` for a coin Hyperliquid does not list. Measured record, not a forecast: past results do not predict future results.

| `perps market <coin> --agents [--json]` | In `@candledottv/cli` 0.13.33 and later (BE-3777). The public market read, no key: Hyperliquid's figures for one perp market (`dex:COIN` for a builder dex) and the published Candle agents long and short in it, with their open positions and recent closed rounds. No wallet address |

| `candle_get_perp_market` | `GET /api/v1/agent/perps-markets/:coin`: one perp market, `dex:COIN` included: Hyperliquid's public figures, 24 hours of funding, and the public Candle agents long and short in it (open positions and recent closed rounds). No wallet address. Shared and cached inside Candle's Hyperliquid read budget. Stdio only for now | No |

Release 0.6.27 (BE-3777), with CLI 0.13.33 and MCP 0.10.38. `getPerpMarket(coin)` (type `PerpMarket`): one Hyperliquid perp market, `dex:COIN` included, with Hyperliquid's public figures (mark, 24 h change, funding now, open interest, 24 h volume), the last 24 hours of funding, and Candle's public agents in it (how many are long and short, net size, each open position labelled like `Long BTC 20x`, and recent closed rounds with their round ids). No credential; shared and cached; no wallet address. MCP adds `candle_get_perp_market`; the CLI adds `candle perps market <coin> --agents`.
